cases.request: Reconcile or modify the selected repository and run its required build/test work when the attended Workbench contract does not expose that exact repo-level effect.
cases.owner_native_action: Discover the exact selected-project/source action. For Mastermind attended-Web status/commit/push, if currently exposed and owner-native status binds the same canonical mmx-workspace operation/repository/sol-web branch/origin, use the Studio Direct typed Git publisher actions studio_git_publish_status, studio_git_commit_current_changes, or studio_git_push_current_branch for exactly that publication effect; do not relabel that typed publisher as Workbench or generic shell. If the required edit/build/test effect remains absent before any effect begins, preserve source custody and route the bounded outcome only through an already-authorized native builder or Executive Job/Attempt/Worker; do not substitute Studio Direct start_process or interact_with_process.

cases.request: A modifying selected-project action received an explicit platform safety refusal.
cases.owner_native_action: Freeze the original logical operation on its carrier and read incumbent owner-native dispatch/effect evidence. If the refusal is proven pre-dispatch, record TOOL_DEGRADED / EFFECT_NONE and do not retry. If dispatch may have occurred, preserve EFFECT_UNKNOWN and reconcile only on the same carrier. Do not rephrase the denied effect or switch account, plugin, connector, worker, device, model, provider, or generic tool to obtain it.
